title: Unit tests for dynamicLoadMultiplier (src/economy/pricing.ts)
instructions:
Add a new vitest unit test file `tests/economy/dynamic-load-multiplier.test.ts` for `dynamicLoadMultiplier` in `src/economy/pricing.ts`.
- Read the code first (it is pasted below) and assert what it actually does; if you think the code has a bug, say so in your final answer instead of changing it.
- Use `import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";` and import the code under test with a relative path ending in `.js` (for example `../../src/economy/pricing.js`), like the other tests in this repository.
- Read DynamicPriceInputs in the same file and build complete input objects. Cover: demand equal to capacity gives 1.0; an idle network gives the floor; extreme demand is capped at 4.0; cpu and gpu use their own capacity field; a capacity of 0 is treated as 1.
